verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say the platform can "automate questionnaires" as part of accelerating security reviews, so questionnaire automation is in scope. Nothing in the pack shows importing SIG, CAIQ, portal or spreadsheet questionnaires, or exporting answers back in the customer's original format. Missing for 10: documented support for SIG/CAIQ formats, spreadsheet import/export, portal-based questionnaire handling, format-preserving export, and any independent or hands-on confirmation.
